annotation.bound_parties_text: The standard is aimed at manufacturers of industrial robots, safety engineers, and integrators involved in the design and production of robotic systems.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Manufacturers of industrial robots, safety engineers, and integrators who are involved in the design and production of robotic systems will find ISO 10218-1 essential.
annotation.dates_quote: This document is not applicable to robots that are manufactured before the date of its publication.
annotation.legal_effect_quote: Helps manufacturers meet international safety standards, which is essential for market acceptance and regulatory approval
annotation.robot_provision_quote: ISO 10218-1 establishes guidelines for the safety requirements specific to industrial robots
